title_en: When do you drink your favorite drink?
paras_en: Hello, my name is Elizabeth. I'm from America, and my question is, when do you drink your favorite drink?

I drink my favorite drink in the morning. I love hot tea. I like honey with my tea. I like to drink tea in the morning. It is quiet. I like to read a book. I also like to drink tea at a coffee shop. It is really nice. I do not like tea without honey. I like sweet tea. I also like to drink tea in the evening. I love to watch a movie and drink tea. I also like hot chocolate, but I love hot tea.
My question for you is when do you drink your favorite drink?

title_en: What is your country's geography like?
paras_en: Hi, my name is Elise, and I'm going to talk about the geography of the Netherlands.

In the Netherlands, there are no mountains, but there are some low hills in the south. There's a long coastline, and there are also some islands off the north coast and off the south coast in the west. There are several forests and there are also some provinces with lakes. There are no volcanoes and there aren't any rainforests, either. The climate is temperate, and it's also very humid, so this means that it can rain any day, in any season, any time of the year. So that means if you go out cycling, you must bring a raincoat anytime you go out cycling.
Are there any distinct geographical features in your region?

title_en: Do you watch sports on TV?
paras_en: Hello, my name is Hazal and I'm from Turkiye. My question is, do you watch sports on TV?

Yes, I watch sports on TV. I like to watch tennis the most because I like how the players hit the ball and move quickly. Another sports I like to watch is volleyball because I like teamwork, and the rules of volleyball is very interesting. One sports that I don't like to watch is football because I find it boring, but my father loves it, so sometimes I watch it. I think watching sports on TV is a great activity to do with family and friends because it is a great way to enjoy and relax.
Hello, my name is Hazal and I'm from Turkey. My question is, what snacks are healthy?

Fruits are a good choice for healthy snacks. You can eat apples, bananas, or grapes for healthy choices. Another choice is vegetables. If you want to eat a salty snack, you can choose carrots or cucumbers. Another good choice is nuts, like walnuts or peanuts, but you should not eat them too much. You can also eat yogurt because it is also another good choice for a healthy snack. You can mix yogurt with some good fruits to make it even more tasty. You can also eat dark chocolate for a healthy choice, but it should not be too much.

title_en: When do you start and finish your day?
paras_en: Hi, my name's Nerrisa, and I'm from the Philippines. My question is, when do you start and finish your day?

My day starts at seven o'clock in the morning. I work from home, so I don't need to rush in the morning. My work starts at eight o'clock, so I have an hour to prepare. I wash my face, I make coffee, and then I check my schedule on the computer. During my free time, I do my hobbies, like coloring and playing online games. I also cook and clean my home. In the afternoon, I take a nap and a shower before working again at 5:00 PM. I finish work at 9:00 PM, and then I do my routine afterwards, my night routine. My day usually finishes at around 11 in the evening.
What about you? When do you start and finish your day?

title_en: What is your favorite TV show?
paras_en: Hello, my name is Nerry, and I am from Belize. My question today is, what is your favorite TV show?

My favorite TV show is called Dexter. It is a show about a man named Dexter. Dexter is a police detective who kills bad people. Not everyone likes Dexter because the show involves a lot of blood. I enjoy watching crime shows and detective shows. That is why I love Dexter.
My question to you is, what is your favorite TV show?

title_en: What do you do in the morning?
paras_en: Hello, my name is Rocio, and I am from El Salvador. My question is, what do you do in the morning?

In the morning, I wake up at 6:00 AM. I brush my teeth, and I wash my face. I then eat breakfast. I like to eat eggs with toasts and avocado. I don't drink coffee, so I drink water or orange juice. After breakfast, I get ready to start work at 7:00 AM. Since I work from home, I don't take the bus or drive my car. During the morning. I also take a break, so sometimes I go for a walk with my dog around the park.
And you, what do you do in the morning?

title_en: What can you do in the park?
paras_en: Hi everybody. Hi, this is Todd, your teacher from ELLLO, and today I'm in a park in Seoul, Korea, and it is a beautiful, beautiful park, and you can do many things in this park.

You can take lovely pictures of the city. You can actually see the entire city because it's on a hill, so you have a great view. You can see things here that you cannot see down on the street, and you can relax. It's quiet. You can read a book, you can stretch out on the grass, but it's kind of a nature park. So you can't play sports, you can't do exercise. But Korea has some great parks near the river, and the parks near the river are perfect for sports. You can run, you can ride a bike, you can play sports, you can do exercise, you can even lift weights. They have little weight machines down there and you can exercise. They have these all over Korea, actually. So you can definitely get exercise in Korea and you don't have to go to a gym. So the parks in Korea are fantastic, some of the best in the world. You can do so many things in these parks, and that's one of the reasons I really, really love coming to Korea.

My job is to teach English. I am an English teacher. I teach English to my students. I teach how to read, write, and speak English. Sometimes we do activities in the class. We watch English movies. We play English games, and we listen to English music. I love my students, and my students love me. I like my school. I teach English because I like to help people. I love my job.

It's Sunday, and I like to come to the beach on Sunday because it's quieter and it's more peaceful. It's just a really nice time of year, you know. I like the fall because it's just prettier. I think the weather is nicer, the scenery is more beautiful, and it's cooler. It's not so hot. So I really, really like the fall, so I'm having a good day today, enjoying myself at the beach.

I hope so. I'm happier right now because the weather is cooler, and it's not so hot.

title_en: What are monthly events in your area?
paras_en: Hi, I'm Elise, and I'm going to talk about the weather and festivities in Peru.

In January, it's summer and lots of people go to the beach at the coast. Children are on summer holiday. In February, they celebrate carnival by throwing lots of water balloons at each other. In March, children go back to school. In April, they celebrate Easter with some really delicious special breads. In May, lots of tourists start coming to Peru, and it's quite cold because it's almost winter.

In June, there are a lot of religious festivities. One of the most important ones is called in Inti Raymi, and this happens in Cusco. In July, they celebrate Independence Day at the end of the month. In August, children have two weeks of holiday again. In September, there aren't many festivities, and winter is almost over.

In October, there's a very important religious festival called Lord of the Miracles. It's biggest in Lima. In November, it starts heating up a little bit, and the rainy season sometimes starts in the mountains and in the jungle, too. In December, it's definitely the rainy season and children start looking forward to their summer holiday.
